tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: FREE. List/search the vendors 60SecMonitor tracks (slug, name, category). Use before paying to confirm a vendor is tracked.

tools.name: validate_vendor
tools.description: FREE. Check a vendor name/domain format before paying. Format only; use list_vendors to confirm it is tracked.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: FREE. Prices, network and payment address for the paid tools.

tools.name: vendor_status
tools.description: Is this vendor down? Current status, confidence, active incidents, 30-day uptime and freshness for one SaaS/cloud vendor, read live from 60SecMonitor. Unknown vendors return an error and are not charged.

tools.name: multi_vendor_status
tools.description: Status of up to 25 vendors in one call (one flat price), read live from 60SecMonitor. Lists which are not operational. Not charged if none is tracked or every lookup fails.
